name: BigModel 开放平台
desc: Zhipu's API platform and console for the GLM family
desc_zh: 智谱 GLM 系列的 API 平台与控制台
solves: Picking a domestic provider means comparing prices, reading docs and stitching one API per vendor. BigModel is one key, one console, metered by usage.
solves_zh: 选一家国产服务商要比价、读文档、再为每家拼一次接口。BigModel 是一个密钥、一个后台，按量计费。
best_for: A model inside your own service, rather than in a web chat tab.
best_for_zh: 要在自家服务里接一个模型，而不是开网页聊两句。
